name: Remington Keratin Protect Intelligent Hair Straightener | Model FR-2110 | Advanced Ceramic Plates with Heat Protection Technology
description:
Achieve smooth, shiny, and healthier-looking hair with the Remington Keratin Protect Intelligent Hair Straightener. Designed with advanced keratin protection technology, this premium hair straightener combines ceramic-coated styling plates infused with keratin micro-conditioners and an intelligent heat protection sensor for enhanced hair care during styling. The innovative heat protection sensor continuously monitors and adjusts the temperature while styling, helping reduce excessive heat exposure and providing up to 57% more protection against hair damage. The advanced ceramic plates glide smoothly through hair, reducing frizz and delivering salon-quality straightening results with every use. Perfect for everyday styling, this intelligent hair straightener helps create sleek, straight hairstyles while maintaining your hair's natural shine and softness.

Key Features
Intelligent Keratin Protect Technology
Up to 57% more hair protection
Advanced ceramic-coated styling plates
Keratin-infused micro-conditioners
Intelligent heat protection sensor
Smooth gliding plates for effortless styling
Reduces frizz and enhances shine
Even heat distribution for consistent results
Suitable for daily hair straightening
Professional salon-style performance

How to Use
Ensure hair is clean and completely dry
Plug in and select desired temperature setting
Activate the heat protection sensor if available
Divide hair into sections
Glide the straightener slowly from root to tip
Repeat as needed for desired styling results

Material / Composition
Advanced Ceramic-Coated Plates
Keratin Micro-Conditioning Technology
Heat Protection Sensor System
Durable Heat-Resistant Housing

Safety Information
For dry hair only
Avoid contact with water while plugged in
Do not touch hot plates during operation
Unplug after use and allow to cool completely
Keep out of reach of children

Package Includes
1 × Remington Keratin Protect Intelligent Hair Straightener
